newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: LG Metals shrs up on gold project talk.
newsitem.headline: LG Metals shrs up on gold project talk.

text.p: Shares of LG Metals Corp rose to their daily limit in late Friday trading on news that it was negotiating to take a 51-percent stake in a gold mining project in Mali, brokers said.
The shares climbed eight percent, or 1,100 won, to 14,900 won just before the close.
LG Metals has been negotiating with Afko Korea Inc, which holds the right to develop a gold mine in Mali, for the stake, officials at the two companies said.
"The news boosted buying in the company's shares, which were also in demand for bargain hunting after sharp decline yesterday," said a Hyundai Securities broker.
Shares of LG Metals fell to their daily limit on Thursday on rumours that it faced a financial difficulties on the London Metal Exchange due to big speculative positions.
LG Metals denied the rumours and said no loss had been made from futures trading. --Seoul Newsroom (822) 727 5646
